about.title: La Canada Flintridge Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Grief rarely leaves room for paperwork, yet California's wrongful death rules begin counting on the day a person dies. In La Canada Flintridge, the 2025 public record lists 67 injury collisions and 101 people hurt, with no traffic deaths counted that year, which can make a fatal loss feel all the more isolating when it does happen. Foothill Boulevard, the 210 Freeway and the long climb up Angeles Crest Highway (Route 2) account for most of the city's reported crashes, and a death on any of those roads, or in a fall, a medical setting or a workplace, may give surviving relatives the right to bring a civil action. That action stands apart from any criminal case and does not wait on one. Standing belongs first to a spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. We handle wrongful death claims on contingency, so there is no charge to reach out and no fee unless we recover compensation for your family.

whyChoose.title: Why Families in La Canada Flintridge Choose Us

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. Our team can sort out who in your family qualifies before anything is filed.

items.title: Respect for the two-year deadline
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting in touch early protects your options.

items.title: A full picture of recoverable losses
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance can all be part of a claim. We pursue these on contingency at no upfront cost to you.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on Angeles Crest Highway. Is a wrongful death claim possible?
items.answer: It may be, if another driver, a vehicle defect or another party's negligence contributed to the crash. Angeles Crest Highway and Route 2 appear among La Canada Flintridge's highest-volume collision corridors in public records, and fatal crashes there are investigated like any other. We can review the collision report and tell you whether a civil claim is realistic for your family.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, separate from any criminal prosecution. Your family's two-year deadline keeps running regardless of what happens in criminal court, so it makes sense to speak with us sooner rather than later.

items.question: What if a city or state agency may be partly responsible for the death?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity in California follow a much shorter timeline than the standard two years, and they usually begin with a formal claim rather than a lawsuit. Because the deadline is tight, this is one of the first questions we will want to address. Contact us at no cost so nothing is missed.
